title: 第15章 斗姆元君修为突破第16章 龙魂岛和氏璧与天问剑
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
当这颗流星快要接近赢天时，便开始减缓了下坠的速度。
随后紫光消散，一位紫发紫眸，气质出尘，模样倾国的仙女，缓缓浮现在赢天面前。
赢天看着眼前的仙女，好奇的问道：“不知这位仙女姐姐，是哪位神仙？”
仙女闻言，捂嘴轻笑道道：“没想到小郎君，年纪虽小，但这小嘴倒是挺甜~”
“再配上你这模样，以后不知道，会有多少女子着了你的道~”
“本宫众星之母，斗姆元君，见过小郎君。”
赢天闻言讪讪一笑道：“哈哈~我长相一般，哪有那么夸张？斗姆姐姐过奖了。”
斗姆元君翻了个白眼道：“小郎君你这脸皮都快有那城墙厚了~”
赢天闻言尴尬笑道：“斗姆姐姐为何会选择我呢？”
斗姆元君闻言，看着天上的星星说道：“星星告诉本宫，小郎君是一个不错的人，所以本宫就来了。”
“只是可惜，本宫没能让那几个孩子一起过来…”
“真是的~为什么那么倔呢？一家团圆不好吗？”
赢天淡笑道：“可能他们也有他们自己的想法吧？”
“斗姆姐姐就别伤心了，以后我带你去找他们就是了~”
斗姆元君摇头叹气道：“算了~以后是敌是友都不清楚~既然如此，那还不如别见了~”
赢天轻轻点头道：“斗姆姐姐，放心吧~以后就算是敌对了，我也不会让你为难的~”
斗姆元君点头道：“有你这句话，本宫就放心了~”
随后斗姆元君看向通天教主与祖龙说道：“斗姆元君，见过通天，祖龙两位道友。”
通天教主与祖龙点头道：“圆明道友。”
斗姆元君点头道：“两位道友，本宫就先行一步了，寄灵空间再会~”

说完化作一道星光进入了赢天的寄灵空间之中。
看着消失了的斗姆元君，赢天转头看向了通天教主和祖龙。
笑嘻嘻的说道：“两位前辈，最后一道机缘，都就位了，你们还在磨蹭什么呢？”
通天教主与祖龙闻言，相视一笑后，化作一道剑光与龙影，进入了赢天的体内。
始皇见状笑道：“小天啊~寡人为你求来的，这个礼物如何？”
赢天笑着点头道：“十七位世间最顶级的守护灵，这是世上，最独一无二的礼物了。”
“只是…先祖恐怕付出了不小的代价？”
始皇闻言大笑道：“满意就行了，至于代价嘛…不过是几个条件而已~”
“你只要做好，你该做的就行了，其他的无需担心~”
赢天闻言刚要询问，始皇便化作一道龙影，进入了寄灵空间之内。
赢天现状只能作罢，但心里却不免的生起了，对始皇的担心。
能说动这几位，付出的代价，怎么会那么简单？
但现在想这些也没用，还是抓紧时间努力变强，拥有足够的实力，才是王道。
想完，赢天便向着，上课的地方，继续跟着，家族高价聘请来的家教上课。
课后，赢天便回到了独属于自己的院子的密室中，开始盘腿修炼。
随着赢天，进入修炼状态后。
content_en:
When the meteor was approaching the sky, it began to slow down.
Then the purple light dissipated, and a fairy with purple hair, purple eyes, an extraordinary temperament, and an alluring appearance slowly appeared in front of Yingtian.
Yingtian looked at the fairy in front of him and asked curiously: "I wonder who this fairy sister is?"
Hearing this, the fairy covered her mouth and smiled softly: "I didn't expect that although the young man is young, his little mouth is quite sweet~"
"With your appearance, I don't know how many women will fall for you in the future~"
"The mother of all the stars in this palace, Dou Mu Yuanjun, has met Xiaolangjun."
Yingtian heard the words and smiled coquettishly: "Haha~ I look average, how can I be so exaggerated? Sister Doumu is so flattering."
Doumu Yuanjun rolled his eyes and said, "Xiao Langjun, your face is almost as thick as that of the city wall~"
Hearing this, Yingtian smiled awkwardly and said, "Why did Sister Doumu choose me?"
When Doumu Yuanjun heard this, he looked at the stars in the sky and said, "The stars told me that Xiaolangjun is a good person, so I came here."
"It's just a pity that I couldn't let those children come together..."
"Really~ Why are you so stubborn? Isn't it good to have a family reunion?"
Yingtian smiled lightly and said, "Maybe they also have their own ideas?"
"Sister Doumu, don't be sad, I will take you to find them in the future~"
Doumu Yuanjun shook his head and sighed: "Forget it~ From now on, I don't know whether I am an enemy or a friend~ In this case, it is better not to see each other~"
Yingtian nodded lightly and said: "Sister Doumu, don't worry~ Even if we are hostile in the future, I will not make it difficult for you~"
Doumu Yuanjun nodded and said, "With your words, I feel relieved~"
Then Doumu Yuanjun looked at Tongtian Cult Master and Zulong and said, "Doumuyuanjun, I have met Tongtian and Zulong, my two Taoist friends."
Leader Tongtian and Zulong nodded and said: "Fellow Taoist Yuanming."
Doumu Yuanjun nodded and said: "Two fellow Taoists, I will go ahead and see you in the spirit space~"
After saying that, he turned into a starlight and entered Yingtian's spiritual space.
Looking at Lord Doumu Yuan who had disappeared, Yingtian turned to look at Master Tongtian and Zulong.
He said with a smile: "Two seniors, the last opportunity is in place, what are you still dawdling about?"
Hearing this, Master Tongtian and Zulong looked at each other and smiled, then turned into a sword light and dragon shadow, and entered Yingtian's body.
Seeing this, the First Emperor smiled and said, "My dear, I asked for this for you. How about this gift?"
Yingtian smiled and nodded: "Seventeen of the best guardian spirits in the world. This is the most unique gift in the world."
"It's just that...the ancestors must have paid a heavy price?"
The First Emperor laughed and said, "As long as you are satisfied, as for the price...it's just a few conditions~"
"As long as you do what you should do, don't worry about the rest~"
When Yingtian heard the words and was about to ask, the First Emperor turned into a dragon shadow and entered the spirit space.
Yingtian could only give up on the current situation, but he couldn't help but worry about the First Emperor in his heart.
How could the price paid to convince these people be so simple?
But it's useless to think about it now. It's better to seize the time and work hard to become stronger and have enough strength.
After thinking about it, Yingtian headed towards the place where the class was held and continued to follow the tutor hired by the family at a high price.
After class, Yingtian returned to the secret room in his own courtyard and began to practice cross-legged.
Following Yingtian, after entering the state of cultivation.
